searches.reason: Find mechanisms that let one NextItNet network selectively forget stale evidence throughout its convolution paths and residual shortcuts. Existing update gates cannot remove information already carried by shortcuts. Compare a bounded-history control with learned forgetting; sparse replacement probes do not yet establish that older history is harmful.

searches.reason: Explore false-negative-aware candidate learning beyond simply increasing negative count. Electronics’ 6.84% sampled training wrong-rank rate motivates testing better discrimination, while aggressive mining may penalize plausible unobserved positives. Seek practical objectives using the same jointly trained network, without teachers or auxiliary fitted scorers.

searches.reason: Investigate a jointly trained title/description encoder that conditions NextItNet representations on specific item attributes and recent context. This could address broad-association errors through richer evidence rather than additional history gates. Require training from scratch on supplied text; treat compatibility and unmet need as unobserved unless explicitly supported by available descriptions.
